name: dev.leclap/video
title: LeClap
description: Compose and render video from one JSON template. Deterministic, runs locally, no generative model.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory rendered videos are written to. Defaults to ~/.leclap/renders.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_MEDIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Allowlisted directory the server may read source media from. Defaults to ~/.leclap/media.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Separate queue, effect-preflight and worker setup/render deadlines in milliseconds, not an end-to-end budget. Defaults to 600000.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTION
environmentVariables.description: Enable effect discovery, effect previews and the Remotion clip renderer. Rendering executes local JavaScript. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_REMOTION_ENTRY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the operator-configured trusted Remotion entry point for clip rendering and registered JSON effects.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_REMOTION_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Path to a compatible Chrome executable. If omitted, Remotion sets up its browser.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_EFFECT_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Persistent registered-effect cache budget in bytes. Defaults to 536870912 (512 MiB); 0 disables caching.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_EFFECT_CATALOG
environmentVariables.description: Operator JSON effect catalog loaded and validated once at startup. Restart after catalog edits.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check that returns a fixed readiness string.

tools.name: list_samples
tools.description: Discover packaged showcase samples, creative direction, required inputs and native or Remotion setup.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Retrieve a sample descriptor with embedded partials and its input requirements, without downloading media or rendering.

tools.name: get_template_schema
tools.description: Return the authoritative template descriptor JSON Schema plus the authoring guide.

tools.name: validate_template
tools.description: Validate a template without rendering and report the clips and fields compose_video will require.

tools.name: compose_video
tools.description: Render a template to an MP4 with FFmpeg and return the output path.

tools.name: probe_media
tools.description: Inspect a local media file and report stream codecs, duration, audio sample rate and size.

tools.name: render_remotion_clip
tools.description: Render a composition from your own Remotion project to an MP4. Gated — see notes.

tools.name: get_effect_schema
tools.description: Discover a registered JSON effect, its strict props and assets, output metadata, and runtime requirements.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Preview frames or a short frame range of a registered JSON effect using trusted local Remotion source.

tools.name: patch_template
tools.description: Apply effect-prop edits to inline template JSON atomically using an expected revision, returning the updated template.

dev.leclap.video.notes: Eight tools are always registered. get_effect_schema, render_preview and render_remotion_clip require the Remotion opt-in. Registered JSON effects use operator-configured trusted source and require a configured backend for validation, patching and rendering; callers cannot select executable source through effect JSON. patch_template remains registered when Remotion is disabled.
